top_signals.title: Copper Set for Weekly Gain on China’s Return and Supply Concerns
top_signals.summary: Copper headed for a weekly gain, as signs of Chinese demand and possible supply disruption at a Chilean mine boosted the metal.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Dutch firm uses AI to help drone systems ‘talk’ on Ukraine’s battlefield
top_signals.summary: Amsterdam-based Intelic now has an office in Kyiv and is helping Ukrainian forces as they face intensified Russian drone and missile barrages.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Nvidia-Backed Firmus IPO Collapses
top_signals.summary: Firmus has abandoned its attempt at one of Australia’s biggest-ever initial public offerings after failing to lure global investors. Bloomberg’s Manuel Baigorri says the news comes amid global concerns over frothy AI valuations (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Philippines to Adopt International Bond Pricing to Woo Investors
top_signals.summary: The Philippines will adopt international pricing conventions for peso-denominated government bonds effective next year, a shift it says should attract more participants and help lower its borrowing costs.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.
